subject: Change the shared format for dual channel replication logs (#1586)
reason: The change only alters the log-message prefix string in the dualChannelServerLog macro (from "<Dual Channel> " to "Dual channel replication: ") and updates the matching pattern in the dual-channel-replication test. It is a cosmetic log-format change with no effect on replication behaviour, replies, data, or control flow, so there is no risky path for a fuzzer scenario to exercise.
